name: Amon
overview: The name Amon refers to several biblical figures, including a king of Judah who reigned for two years following his father Manasseh. According to 2 Kings 21:18-22, Amon continued in the evil ways of his father, serving idols and forsaking the LORD God of his fathers. His reign ended abruptly when his own servants conspired against him and killed him in his house. Additionally, Amon is noted as a governor of Samaria and as an ancestor of one of the families of the Nethinim, sometimes called Ami.
